subject.title: fix: settings page fails to load when the deployed backend predates the listMine args change

question: Should the deploy-skew mitigation land as a temporary compatibility rollback, or should the backend validator be deployed first so Settings can keep its bounded membership query?
rationale: Both choices resolve the immediate error, but only maintainers can choose the acceptable operational rollout and performance tradeoff for deployed clients.

options.title: Deploy the compatible backend first
options.body: Deploy the `listMine` validator that accepts `includePublishedItems` before retaining the bounded Settings query, avoiding a permanent payload regression.

options.title: Land a time-bounded fallback
options.body: Accept `{}` only as an explicitly tracked temporary rollback, then restore the bounded query after production validation of the backend rollout.

recommendation.title: Deploy the compatible backend first
recommendation.body: Deploy the `listMine` validator that accepts `includePublishedItems` before retaining the bounded Settings query, avoiding a permanent payload regression.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged bounded-read work whose Settings query contract and performance goal are directly affected.
